title: A Collective has a network home: one shared calendar and a directory of its member Spaces
detail: PHASE 8 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709), built on the collaborator calendar. Required before Founding Collective sells. Public network home now composes eligible same-owner active network member Spaces and the existing published-event tenancy/hosting/accepted-share reader. Every month re-resolves caller-visible parent and child eligibility; owner management remains a separate billing door. Cancellations stay calendar context and never lead Up next. 47 focused visibility/cross-tenant, calendar and server-render checks pass, along with full typecheck. Public directory and each month load recheck source access; the plain-Node consequence probe remains runner-free. Deployment follows LIVE-763.
